question: Which protected DevelopmentAuthorityLedger trust-source topology should constrain the later exact persistence, authentication, signing, credential, and transport contract?

options.summary: Protected signed snapshot artifacts — reconstruct from explicitly selected immutable local or CI snapshots verified against separately configured trust anchors.
options.consequence: Use content-identified append-only snapshots with no candidate or current-directory discovery. This supports offline reconstruction and direct rollback but requires an accepted signing mechanism, trust-anchor operation, protected artifact publication, and credential policy.

options.summary: Authenticated protected CI/service source — obtain immutable authority snapshots from a protected issuer and retain an identity-bound export for local reconstruction.
options.consequence: Centralize issuance, revocation, and authentication behind protected CI or service controls. This reduces repository-adjacent trust material but adds service availability, transport, credential, cache, and recovery obligations.

options.summary: Reconsider or defer protected ledger realization.
options.consequence: Keep authority-context reconstruction and every dependent protected-operation route blocked; implement no unauthenticated or repository-derived substitute.

recommendation: Option A. Explicit protected signed snapshots align most directly with the accepted local and CI reconstruction modes, make complete immutable inputs and rollback inspectable, and avoid introducing a service boundary before one is required. Exact signing and trust-anchor mechanics still require explicit acceptance and must not add a dependency without separate authorization.
blocked_scope: Selection of the protected ledger trust-source topology; subsequent exact persistence, authentication, signing, credential, transport, snapshot, and record-wire review; context resolver and reconstruction receipt implementation; exact operation authorizer integration; every protected target operation; dependency, external-service, protected-execution, publication, or release work.
safe_scope: Human review of Options A through C and docs/architecture/migration/v1-to-v2/implementation/harness/decisions-authority.md; deterministic validation and persistence of this planning boundary.
authorized_scope: Adopt explicitly selected protected signed snapshot artifacts as the DevelopmentAuthorityLedger trust-source topology for local and CI reconstruction. Proceed with bounded exact signing, trust-anchor, credential, protected publication, persistence, transport, reconstruction-receipt, compatibility, and rollback contract planning. Do not add a dependency, handle real credentials, perform protected execution, activate a successor, publish, or release.
resumption_status: option_A_resolved; exact protected ledger mechanism planning resumed; implementation remains unauthorized
